stepTitle: $$\cos(Ax)=0$$ occurs when $$x=\frac{\pm \pi}{2}$$. \n $$\cos(Bx)=0$$ at $$x=\pm 1$$. Which graph represents a function with a higher frequency?

figureAlts.figure1.gif: Two cosine curves: cos of Ax has horizontal axis crossing at pi over 2 and negative pi over 2; cos of Bx has horizontal axis crossing at 1 and negative 1.
